intro.fallback: Yūkimaru manages to hold off the Three-Tails long enough for Guren to stand up, who moves out of the way just as the Three-Tails regains its self-control.
Rinji stealthily stabs Guren with his kunai and moves Yūkimaru and himself out of the way as the Three-Tails' Water Release: Great Water Mass Bullet strikes the cliff.
Seeing the wounded Guren, Yūkimaru is told that she will die unless he takes control of the Three-Tails.

outro.fallback: Rinji flees as Yūkimaru decides to protect Guren with his life.
As the Three-Tails launches another attack, Guren moves him out of the way and keeps him safely encased with her Crystal Release: Crimson Fruit while she deals with the tailed beast.
